rows.note: Use this as the default choice for the freshness or newness of something.

example.english: There was still a real novelty to the first few days after moving into the new flat.
example.traditional: 搬咗新屋頭幾日仲好有新鮮感。
example.jyutping: bun1 zo2 san1 uk1 tau4 gei2 jat6 zung6 hou2 jau5 san1 sin1 gam2

rows.note: Use this when “novelty” means a newly launched tangible product, rather than abstract innovation.

example.english: This shop's newly launched product is the novelty everyone is talking about.
example.traditional: 呢間舖啱啱推出嘅新產品，成為大家討論嘅新鮮事。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ngaam1 ngaam1 teoi1 ceot1 ge3 san1 caan2 ban2 sing4 wai4 daai6 gaa1 tou2 leon6 ge3 san1 sin1 si6

rows.note: Use this for a small, usually mass-produced trinket or novelty item.

example.english: You can find these little novelty trinkets all over the tourist area.
example.traditional: 呢啲小玩意喺旅客區周圍都有得賣。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 siu2 wun6 ji3 hai2 leoi5 haak3 keoi1 zau1 wai4 dou1 jau5 dak1 maai6
